datasets.name: bottleneck_trend
queryLines:
WITH task_runs AS (
  SELECT
    job_run_id,
    task_key,
    MIN(period_start_time) AS run_started,
    CAST(SUM(period_end_time - period_start_time) AS LONG) AS duration_seconds
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline
  WHERE
    period_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND job_id IN (818230914419317, 288555998184699, 930495625009104)
  GROUP BY
    ALL
)
SELECT
  CAST(run_started AS DATE) AS run_date,
  task_key,
  COUNT(DISTINCT job_run_id) AS runs,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds), 1) AS avg_seconds
FROM
  task_runs
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  run_date,
  task_key

datasets.name: failed_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_id,
  run_id,
  result_state,
  termination_code,
  CAST(SUM(period_end_time - period_start_time) AS LONG) AS duration_seconds
FROM
  system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline
WHERE
  period_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND job_id IN (818230914419317, 288555998184699, 930495625009104)
  AND result_state IS NOT NULL
  AND result_state != 'SUCCEEDED'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  duration_seconds DESC

datasets.name: avg_duration_by_task
queryLines:
SELECT
  task_key,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(period_end_time - period_start_time AS LONG)), 1) AS avg_seconds,
  COUNT(DISTINCT job_run_id) AS total_runs
FROM
  system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline
WHERE
  period_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  AND job_id IN (818230914419317, 288555998184699, 930495625009104)
  AND result_state = 'SUCCEEDED'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  avg_seconds DESC

datasets.name: task_duration_per_run
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_id,
  job_run_id,
  task_key,
  MAX(result_state) AS result_state,
  CAST(SUM(period_end_time - period_start_time) AS LONG) AS duration_seconds
FROM
  system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline
WHERE
  period_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND job_id IN (818230914419317, 288555998184699, 930495625009104)
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  job_run_id,
  task_key
